title: Rav Chiyya son of Rav Avya

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as the leading sage of his generation in Rav Ashi’s time, as in Chullin 18b: Ameimar bar Mar Yenuka said, “I was standing before R’ Chiyya son of Rav Avya.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Chullin 18b passage fully writes Rabbi Chiyya son of Rav Avya, while Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav Chiyya. The supplied full title and this named witness title remain distinct. The status as leading sage and dating to Rav Ashi’s time are Hyman’s claims.

William Davidson Chullin 18b fully writes Rabbi Chiyya son of Rav Avya, while Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav Chiyya. R’ in the translated quotation preserves Hyman’s abbreviation without harmonizing these full titles. The leading-sage description and dating remain Hyman’s claims.
